Round 2 adds the per-call clock (R1), the two-timescale indirect-inference fit (R2), receiving-call kicks (R4) and a scheduler-removal stack with W0 nulls and two partition contrasts, all pre-registered (21:20 UTC) with synthetic validation on real skeletons and a pre-data amendment (B1); R4 normalization post hoc (B2). rationale.faithfulness: The regime-III collective talk memory survives scheduler removal (V5 +0.052; #51 +0.042 [0.014, 0.070]), is uncorrelated with c_x, sits within rooms (Pi ~ 15) and is reproduced by H67's independently fitted read-out gain (ratio 0.96): coupling, not a slow drive. Round-2 scorecard A1 B2 C2 D2 E1 F2 G1 H2 I0. Not holdout-confirmed.
rationale.usefulness: Gives a monitor a cross-check (minute memory vs read-out gain) and an operator lever size: a named message adds 7.3 points of talk probability at the reader's next call and 2.5 one call later; nudge effects are not tenfold.

one_line: Regime-III collective talk memory beyond mean-field Glauber is read-out coupling: it survives scheduler removal (#51 +0.042 [0.014, 0.070]), lives inside rooms (Pi ~ 15) and matches H67's read-out gain (g1_fit/g_lag 0.96); the x9.5 nudge excess is withdrawn.
